description: API endpoint to retrieve favorite restaurants for a user. CRITICAL IDOR vulnerability - accepts userId parameter allowing access to any user's favorites.
notes: CRITICAL IDOR VULNERABILITY: The userId parameter is not validated against the authenticated user's ID. An attacker can change the userId parameter to any value to access favorite restaurants of other users. Example: ?userId=1 will return favorites for user 1, regardless of who is logged in. This is a classic Insecure Direct Object Reference vulnerability.
